description.text: AI-written synthesis of the official page retrieved in this pass, prepared by the collecting assistant: MaRS is Canada’s anchor innovation hub, a place where science, technology and entrepreneurship come together to solve the world’s toughest challenges. We provide startups and scale-ups with commercialization support, connections to capital, customers and talent, as well as access to an expansive community of advisors, researchers and partners. Learn more about how we are driving transformation in health , climate , AI and other key sectors . Work with the people who are driving innovation forward Join Canada’s most connected innovation ecosystem. Founders, funders, researchers, policy-makers, corporates and advisors come together at the MaRS Centre and Waterfront hub to collaborate, spark new ideas and help startups grow. Find out more about our flexible office, lab and event spaces . Whether you’re raising capital, looking to shape your narrative, or testing new markets, MaRS opens doors to vetted investors, customers and partners. Explore our targeted programming for startups. Every founder needs a sounding board. Learn from seasoned advisors and industry experts who’ve built and scaled real companies. MaRS provides tailored support at every stage of growth. Meet our advisors . No application form was opened, and this record does not add a deadline, investment instrument, or eligibility rule beyond that quoted text.
